facts.headline: The Cost of Certainty: How Robot Guesswork Meets Energy Scarcity
facts.summary: Yen-Ling Kuo trains robots to make educated guesses, reducing computational waste while AI data center power demand surges globally. This shift from perfect calculation to probabilistic action reflects a necessary adaptation to resource limits. The pursuit of absolute precision is becoming a luxury our energy systems can no longer afford.
